Mealie Agent Toolkit turns recurring recipe-automation failures into explicit pre-save and post-save checks.

This first release includes:

- an Agent Skills-compatible `mealie-quality-operator` workflow;
- a dependency-free Python auditor for recipes, collections, and meal plans;
- policies and fixtures for food identity, structured fields, method coverage, duplicate detection, plan arithmetic, and linked filters;
- a documented repair performed against a real local Mealie 3.25.1 instance;
- a project website, original launch artwork, platform-specific copy, and an editable 18-second vertical video.

Start with the [README](https://github.com/alanthssss/mealie-agent-toolkit#readme) or explore the [live site](https://alanthssss.github.io/mealie-agent-toolkit/).

This is an independent community project and is not affiliated with Mealie.
